mock.systemHint: A HuiTong mock service stands in for this system and serves synthetic data. It is not connected to Organisation E's live system.
mock.aiHint: Deterministic rules stand in for a language model here. These suggestions demonstrate the workflow; they do not come from a real AI model.
mock.dataHint: Typed sample data stands in for this feature while its owner builds it. Nothing here is read from the database or saved.
